users_select_linked.name: users_select_linked
users_select_linked.using: "users"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid or exists (select 1 from box_users where box_users.user_id = "users"."id")

users_has_contact.name: users_has_contact
users_has_contact.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null

locations_coordinates_valid.name: locations_coordinates_valid
locations_coordinates_valid.value: ("locations"."latitude" is null and "locations"."longitude" is null) or ("locations"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "locations"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

plans_kind_limits.name: plans_kind_limits
plans_kind_limits.value:
case "plans"."kind"
        when 'unlimited' then "plans"."classes_per_week" is null and "plans"."class_count" is null
        when 'weekly_limit' then "plans"."classes_per_week" > 0 and "plans"."class_count" is null
        when 'class_pack' then "plans"."classes_per_week" is null and "plans"."class_count" >= 2
        when 'drop_in' then "plans"."classes_per_week" is null and "plans"."class_count" = 1
      end

personal_records_has_value.name: personal_records_has_value
personal_records_has_value.value: "personal_records"."load_grams" is not null or "personal_records"."time_seconds" is not null or "personal_records"."reps" is not null

workout_components_timer_config.name: workout_components_timer_config
workout_components_timer_config.value:
case "workout_components"."timer_type"
        when 'amrap' then "workout_components"."time_cap_seconds" is not null
        when 'emom' then "workout_components"."interval_seconds" is not null and "workout_components"."rounds" is not null
        when 'tabata' then "workout_components"."work_seconds" is not null and "workout_components"."rest_seconds" is not null and "workout_components"."rounds" is not null
        else true
      end

workout_components_load_percent.name: workout_components_load_percent
workout_components_load_percent.value: "workout_components"."load_percent" is null or ("workout_components"."load_percent" between 1 and 150 and "workout_components"."movement_id" is not null)
